file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Queen's University Belfast Medicine MB BCh BAO A100. Executable production rules live in data/universities/queen-s-belfast-a100.json.

manual_review_scope: A-level routes requiring AS Biology/Human Biology evidence
resit applicants where applicant-specific evidence is required
research_scope.notes: The supplied dossier is the canonical university-specific source. No alternative admissions policy was substituted.

evidence_classification_policy.OFFICIAL: Stated directly by QUB, MSC, UCAS or the UCAT Consortium in the supplied dossier.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: Official QUB Freedom of Information response cited by the supplied dossier.
evidence_classification_policy.APPLYSMART_DERIVED: ApplySmart prediction-band labelling or calibration; not an official QUB band or cut-off.
evidence_classification_policy.UNAVAILABLE: A source or value identified as unpublished or not found.
evidence_classification_policy.MANUAL_REVIEW: Evidence-supported route that Engine v1.0 cannot execute fully without shared-engine changes.

metadata.technical_naming_correction: The runtime spec's active_band_source was aligned to the supplied band configuration key derived_prediction_bands_45_scale. Band values, confidence and methodology were not changed.

route_limited_blockers: Official 2026 interview threshold is not yet published.
No official standard international GCSE+UCAT scoring formula is published.
AS-level Biology/Human Biology evidence is required for some A-level branches but is not executed by the generic Engine v1.0 route checker.
Scottish Higher and Irish Junior Certificate academic-point scoring are documented but not executed by the generic GCSE component-sum scorer.
engine_execution_boundaries: Standard Home A-level and IB applicants can receive a prediction when eligibility, GCSE scoring and UCAT decile inputs are complete.
Contextual NI BT-postcode applicants are routed separately and do not receive the standard GCSE+UCAT prediction.
Verified QUB POP completers receive guaranteed-interview handling after academic eligibility checks pass.
International applicants are routed separately and do not receive a derived Home prediction band.
SJT is tie-break only and does not affect the main numeric score.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports the standard Home pre-interview formula and derived ApplySmart bands on the official 45-point scale. Documented route boundaries are explicitly suppressed or sent to review.

course_identity.medical_school: School of Medicine, Dentistry and Biomedical Sciences

selection_model.stage_1: Interview shortlisting uses the official pre-interview score: GCSE points plus UCAT decile points.
selection_model.stage_2: Final offers are based solely on MMI performance.

minimum_subjects: Mathematics grade C/4 if not offered at AS/A-level
Physics grade C/4 or Double Award Science CC/44 if Physics not offered at AS/A-level

standard_routes: AAA plus A in a fourth AS-level, including A-level Chemistry plus at least one other A-level from Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics; AS Biology/Human Biology required if not held at A-level
A*AA including Chemistry and Biology/Human Biology
A*AA including Chemistry and Mathematics or Physics plus AS Biology/Human Biology grade B
a_level.engine_status: A*AA Chemistry plus Biology/Human Biology route executable; AS-specific branches routed to manual review.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 36 points with 6,6,6 including Chemistry and Biology at Higher Level
international_baccalaureate.engine_status: Eligibility route executable when complete IB and GCSE scoring evidence is supplied.

scottish.advanced_higher_requirement: Chemistry grade A plus one of Biology/Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics at A; offer profile depends on Higher performance.
scottish.engine_status: Eligibility can be represented for the AAAAA plus AA route; prediction is suppressed for Scottish-only profiles because Engine v1.0 does not execute the QUB Higher academic-points table.

irish_leaving_certificate.standard: H1 H1 in Biology and Chemistry, H1 H1 H2 H2 at Higher Level, O3 English and Maths at Ordinary if not at Higher, and Physics background evidence.
irish_leaving_certificate.engine_status: Verified Irish route can be routed through international_qualification evidence; prediction is suppressed unless Junior Certificate scoring inputs are represented.

historical_thresholds.cycles_excluded: 2015-2018 are not comparable because grades B/C were not scored before 2019.

contextual_ni_bt_postcode.reason: Alternative shortlisting basis uses AS-level grades, UCAT and predicted A-level performance rather than the standard GCSE score.

international.reason: International applicants are assessed through a separate pathway and QUB has not published an equivalent international scoring methodology.

remaining_evidence_gaps.reason: ApplySmart bands are clearly labelled as derived and use Medium prediction calibration confidence.
International applicants are routed to Not Applicable / International Pathway.
No raw UCAT cut-off is used or converted.
